To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
MFCC is best for feature extraction, GMM is best for feature classification and MFCC+GMM is best for speaker recognition system.
the GMM model is the best model to be used for classification of the speaker.

MFCC has upper hand over all other techniques for feature extractions as it is more robust and consistent with human hearing and GMM is the best suitable candidate among all classification models due to high classification accuracy and less computational time and memory usage.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of automatic speaker recognition.
the development and evaluation of an automatic speech recognition system that is based on the use of a hidden Markov model (HMM).
the development of an automatic speaker identification system based on the Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients (MFCCs) and Gaussian mixture model (GMM) for the speaker recognition task.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MFCC with GMM is the most suitable combination for the feature extraction and feature classification for the ASR system respectively.
MFCC with GMM is the most suitable combination for ASR.
MFCC is the best choice of feature extraction technique for ASR.

the paper is an attempt to give a complete overview of the techniques used in ASR and to give an idea about the performance of the different techniques used in ASRs.

the MFCC is the best choice for feature extraction and GMM is best choice for feature classification for automatic speaker recognition system.
